releaseNotes:
🚀 3.0 Update!

- Fixed: Optimize & launch now optimizes your game first, then launches it. Ads no longer cover or replace the game launch
- Fewer ads: free users now see at most one full-screen ad every 3 minutes, and none during their first couple of actions
- Ads never block what you tapped. The game launches right after any ad closes, even if the ad fails to load
